messages:
Lena Park: Customer asked for a demo: prioritize route-level cost + tail-latency traces + error-slice explorer. They also want a rule to tag 'hot' routes for dedicated sampling. We need to slice M1 (canary) vs M2 (full). Quick take?

Tom Reyes: Quick take: Deliverable A = route cost leaderboard + trace link. Deliverable B = tail-latency (99p) chart per-route. Deliverable C = error-slice explorer (stack/minified logs). A is cheap; B+C are medium.

Priya Kapoor: UX constraints: demo must be non-interactive (read-only) for security; show top 10 routes, one click to open an instrumented trace. No heavy filters for demo.

Nikhil Rao: Instrumentation notes: to get route cost we add per-request cost tags (approx) now. Precise per-token mapping needs backend work. Sampling logic for hot routes: we can tag top-k by QPS or cost. Effort estimate: cost tags + schema migration = 3d; sampling + routing flags = 2d; error-slice backend = 4d.

Arjun Singh: Ops: rolling canary policy — I'd prefer we ship with a partial sampling flag and explicit rollout steps. No automatic rollback. Add an alert when error-slice > baseline by 0.8% within 1h.

Lena Park: Customer acceptance items: 1) leaderboard accuracy >=85% for top-10, 2) trace link resolves to a trace 95% of time, 3) demo latency <2.5s for queries. Reasonable?

Tom Reyes: 85% seems realistic for first pass. We'll label numbers as "estimated" and include a tooltip explaining limitations.

Priya Kapoor: UX acceptance: leaderboard columns = Route, Estimated Cost %, 99p Latency, 5xx Rate, Trace link. Row hover shows small note: "Estimated cost uses sampling-based attribution."

Nikhil Rao: Also propose a soft-cut for demo: no per-region breakdown, no per-customer fine-grained breakdown. Org-level only. That saves us ~2d.

Lena Park: That cut is fine. Customer only asked per-route for demo. We must document roadmap for per-region in M2.

Tom Reyes: Roadmap split suggestion: Sprint 1 (canary/demo): leaderboard (org-level), trace-link plumbing, sampling flag, estimated badge. Sprint 2: attribution improvements, error-slice detail page, per-region optional column.

Arjun Singh: Runbook add: if demo canary causes error spike >1% correlated with tag, immediately disable sampling flag and notify oncall + product. Keep a playbook link in the dashboard header.

infra-bot: Deployment window booked: 2025-03-12 03:00-05:00 UTC for canary rollout. :rocket:

Priya Kapoor: For acceptance checklist, I need a test plan: 1) leaderboard shows top-10 populated, 2) trace links open a trace with span highlighting, 3) demo dataset has intentional 5xx to exercise error-slice. Will add to PRO-501.

Nikhil Rao: Also adding a metric 'cost_attribution_coverage' to track percent of requests with attr tags. We can show this in the dashboard footer during demo.

Lena Park: Action items: Tom create PRO-501 (Demo leaderboard), PRO-502 (Sampling flag + trace links). Nikhil add coverage metric. Arjun draft runbook steps. Priya prepare demo layout mock and small dataset. I'll book customer demo slot for 3/28.

Tom Reyes: I'll assign engineers and mark scope locked for Sprint 1 if no objections. :+1:

Lena Park: Locking demo scope: org-level route leaderboard (estimated cost + 99p latency + 5xx + trace link), sampling flag for hot routes (canary), "estimated" badge + coverage footer. Will post final acceptance criteria in PRO-501 today.

Priya Kapoor: Noted, I'll upload the mock and sample data to the ticket by EOD.

Nikhil Rao: If infra blocks sampling, we'll fallback to static sampling for demo to avoid rolling infra work. Will update ticket.

Arjun Singh: OK. We should be cautious with privacy for traces; ensure trace links for demo are scrubbed or use synthetic traces.

Lena Park: Good call — use synthetic traces for public demo. Thanks everyone.
